# testdata

The compose files and example `.env` files here are copied unchanged from the
projects' repositories, at the versions the rules are based on. They are test
inputs only.

| Directory | Source | License |
|---|---|---|
| `n8n/` | [n8n-io/n8n-hosting@b690a87 docker-compose/withPostgres](https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n-hosting/tree/b690a87c814aed2f56981047fb617d22e488b861/docker-compose/withPostgres) | MIT |
| `openwebui/` | [open-webui/open-webui@v0.12.3 docker-compose.yaml](https://github.com/open-webui/open-webui/blob/v0.12.3/docker-compose.yaml) | Open WebUI License, Copyright (c) 2023- Open WebUI Inc. |
| `litellm/` | [BerriAI/litellm@v1.106.2 docker-compose.yml, .env.example](https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/tree/v1.106.2) | MIT, Copyright (c) 2023 Berri AI |
| `langflow/` | [langflow-ai/langflow@v1.12.7 docker_example/docker-compose.yml](https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/blob/v1.12.7/docker_example/docker-compose.yml) | MIT |
| `flowise/` | [FlowiseAI/Flowise@flowise@3.1.4 docker/](https://github.com/FlowiseAI/Flowise/tree/flowise%403.1.4/docker) | Apache-2.0, Copyright (c) 2023-present FlowiseAI, Inc. |

In each directory, `.env` is the project's `.env.example` (or `.env`) saved under the name Compose reads.
